sequential_dependency.intermediate: The input-dependent normalized orthogonally dilated glyph cell set.
sequential_dependency.step_a: Extract the normalized source glyph from the input, then expand it by one orthogonal cell in every cardinal direction.
sequential_dependency.step_b: Draw the glyph-center network, then center and stamp the stage-A cell set at both detected line endpoints.
sequential_dependency.why_b_depends_on_a: Stage B paints exactly the cells produced by stage A. Replacing the dilated cell set with the undilated canonical glyph changes the protected-Racket final endpoint stamps while leaving the input and network construction fixed.

parametric_work.summary: Exact canonical copy default plus an orthogonal-dilation setting. Episodes support 2–6 demonstrations and four stable novel queries, including substantive 30x30 stress; minimum lessons cross-control same-bounding-box source glyphs to prevent fixed-stamp shortcuts.
